exercises.prompt: Hello! What's your name? Where are you from? How are you?
exercises.sampleAnswer: Hello! My name is Mai. M, A, I. I'm from Thailand. I'm fine, thank you. Nice to meet you!

title.th: อ่านบทสนทนา

instruction.th: อ่านแล้วตอบคำถาม

exercises.text:
Sam: Good morning! I'm Sam.
Mai: Hi, Sam. My name is Mai. Nice to meet you.
Sam: Nice to meet you, too. How are you?
Mai: I'm fine, thank you. And you?
Sam: I'm good, thank you. Where are you from, Mai?
Mai: I'm from Thailand. I'm from Chiang Mai. It is a big city.
Sam: How do you spell Mai?
Mai: M, A, I. This is my friend, Ben.
Sam: Hello, Ben! Nice to meet you.
Ben: Nice to meet you, too. Goodbye, Mai. See you!
